entities.summary: Chris Rodesch is a Luxembourgish professional tennis player. He has a career-high ATP singles ranking of No. 137 achieved on 2 March 2026 and a doubles ranking of No. 500 reached on 28 July 2025. He is currently the No. 1 singles player from Luxembourg.
